entries.headline: ARC Raiders reports an 85% reduction in pre-arranged solo teaming
entries.summary: AUTOMATON relays Embark Studios’ October 1 statement about detecting players who coordinate before entering solo matches and preventing those groups from sharing matches. The studio says teaming participants fell 85% after five days and affected raids dropped from roughly one in 50 to one in 300. Spontaneous in-raid proximity-chat cooperation remains permitted.
